Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 140. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 12 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (60 foot cone)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: End of Target’s next turn
Type: Omni
The user concentrates Ki in front of their eyes and
sends a blinding light forward in a 60-foot cone and
anyone in the area must make a con save or be blinded
for the duration.
